bundle_store_photos_desc: Weekly sales-floor photo submissions and tracking.
store_photos_error_owner_only_delete_pho: Only the owner can delete a photo submission.
store_photos_error_photos_feature_disabl: The Photos feature is not enabled for this store.
notif_photo_archived_body: Photos from :date (:store) were archived; they will be permanently deleted in :days days.
store_photos_photo_cleanup_delay_hint: Days after compression before photos are permanently deleted.
store_photos_photo_confirm_delete: Are you sure you want to delete this submission?
store_photos_photo_max_size_error: Total size exceeds 40 MB limit. Please select fewer or smaller photos.
store_photos_photo_retention_days_hint: How many days before photos are compressed and notified via email.
store_photos_photo_retention_explain: After the retention period expires, photos are compressed and a notification is sent by email. After the cleanup delay, they are permanently deleted.
